meta.title: fix: eliminate double rendering in apps homepage
meta.body_summary: Fix double rendering in apps homepage by removing duplicate NotificationSoundHandler, adding client-side only rendering for AppCard/InstallAppButton, memoizing AllApps, and addressing hydration mismatches.

core_change_summary.description: The PR attempted to fix double rendering in the apps homepage by: removing a duplicate NotificationSoundHandler in layout.tsx; replacing useAutoAnimate with useRef in AllApps.tsx; memoizing AllApps; adding client-side only rendering wrappers for AppCard, InstallAppButton, and slider components; extracting CategoryTab; using a static server-side skeleton; and reverting an SSR wrapper that didn't help.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: A merge from main brought in many unrelated changes to availability pages, admin routes, email templates, and other components, inflating the diff.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: removed duplicate NotificationSoundHandler in layout.tsx and modified homepage page.
Added memoization to AllApps and replaced useAutoAnimate with useRef.
Added client-side only rendering for AppCards and InstallAppButton.
Reverted an SSR wrapper approach on homepage page.
Maintainer merged main, then manually removed the client-side only rendering from AppCard.tsx (hbjORbj).
Devin continued with more client-side rendering for sliders, a skeleton loading state, and extracting CategoryTab.
Final commits added more client-side rendering protection and a static server-side skeleton.
Type check remained failing; PR auto-closed after 7+ days of inactivity.
